title: The 3-Act Commercial Scriptwriting Framework
overview: Structure 30-second and 60-second commercial spots that hook viewers emotionally and motivate brand action.
Draft treatment documents and two-column AV scripts for agency client approval.

takeaways.title: Hook-Problem-Resolution
takeaways.desc: Anchor viewer attention in the first 2.5 seconds with cognitive dissonance.

takeaways.title: Visual Beats
takeaways.desc: Write for the eyes first; dialogue should never explain what images can reveal.
